title: Data quality: validation, contracts and expectation tests

videos.script: Most bad data fails nothing. It loads, and the numbers are wrong. {{silent}} Ana checks the publishers' prices as they arrive. Fix what is certain, reject what is not, count both. {{edge}} Four prices are missing. They go to quarantine, as they arrived, with the reason. {{quarantine}} Half a batch broken is not half a batch of truth. The validator stops, and nothing is loaded. {{batch}} A contract on the report's table. Change a type, and the build refuses. {{contract}} Then the collector delivers a fifth of a day. Every event is valid. {{incident}} Only an expectation sees it: far fewer than usual.
